scenes.title: Face-to-face at UC San Diego: D.S. recoils from his mother while the skin-conductance trace stays flat
scenes.era: 1996-1997, UC San Diego Center for Brain and Cognition clinical room, La Jolla

layout.description: Sunlit 1990s clinical neurology office where 30-year-old Patient D.S. sits at an examination table with two silver skin-conductance finger cuffs wired to a desktop polygraph monitor; his mother stands right across the table extending her hands warmly, while D.S. leans backward pointing at her in suspicion as the green polygraph needle trace runs flat.

positions.who: Patient D.S. (30-year-old mannequin in 1990s polo shirt)
positions.where: seated at the clinical desk with finger electrodes on his left hand, leaning back from his mother
positions.facing: facing his mother across the desk

positions.who: Mother (mannequin in 1990s floral blouse and cardigan)
positions.where: standing across the wooden desk reaching both palms gently forward

positions.who: Neurologist V.S. Ramachandran (mannequin in dark jacket and open-collar shirt)
positions.where: standing beside the desktop skin-conductance monitor
positions.facing: watching both D.S. and the flat horizontal line on the display

props.name: galvanic skin-conductance finger cuffs and monitor
props.period_detail: two silver-chloride finger straps wired to a 1990s benchtop physiological trace screen
props.physical_behavior: horizontal trace line stays completely flat without a spike when D.S. looks at his mother

props.name: stack of family and stranger portrait photographs
props.period_detail: glossy 4x6 color family snapshots spread beside the monitor
props.physical_behavior: D.S. pushes his father's and mother's photos aside as 'doubles'

actions.verb_sequence: steps warmly to the desk -> places a family photograph down and reaches toward D.S.
stares straight at her face -> pulls his torso back into the chair and shakes his head while the skin-conductance trace stays flat

reactions.reaction: draws her hands back to her chest in quiet heartbreak
points to the flat horizontal trace on the monitor

scenes.wardrobe: D.S.: 1990s navy polo shirt and khakis. Mother: cream cardigan over blouse. Neurologist: dark blazer over collared shirt.
scenes.lighting: High-key California window daylight across the clinical desk and monitor.
scenes.recognition_hook: Staring straight into his own mother's eyes, he calls her an impostor while his fingertip sweat monitor stays completely flat.

key_visual.description: the patient leans back from his mother across the clinical desk while the finger electrode monitor shows a flat trace

scenes.title: Family photo album rejection: 'Another D.S., not me'

layout.description: Close tabletop staging with an open 1990s photo album showing parents and a younger snapshot of D.S. himself.

positions.where: seated leaning over the open photo album
seated beside him holding a pen

props.name: open 1990s family photo album
props.physical_behavior: D.S. slides the album away across the desk

actions.verb_sequence: inspects a sharp photo of himself -> taps the photo and pushes the album away as a double

reactions.reaction: notes that even visual self-identity lacks autonomic warmth

scenes.wardrobe: Same 1990s polo shirt and dark blazer.
scenes.recognition_hook: He even pointed at a photograph of himself and said, 'That's another D.S., not me.'

scenes.title: The telephone test: instant warm recognition by voice alone
scenes.era: 1997, adjacent rooms at UC San Diego

layout.description: Split room staging: in the hallway room, the mother speaks into a 1990s corded desk telephone; in the main room, D.S. holds the receiver to his ear and relaxes immediately in warm recognition.

positions.where: seated in the exam room holding the beige corded telephone receiver to his ear
standing in the adjoining room holding the matching telephone handset

props.name: 1990s beige corded desk telephones
props.period_detail: classic push-button office telephones with coiled cords
props.physical_behavior: carry her voice along the intact auditory-to-amygdala route

actions.verb_sequence: lifts the ringing receiver to his ear -> hears his mother's voice -> visibly relaxes his shoulders and nods warmly

reactions.reaction: presses a hand to her heart in relief from the next room

scenes.recognition_hook: Over the phone he knew his real mom in one second — walk her through the door and she became an impostor again.

scenes.title: Two recognition streams: seeing who vs feeling familiarity

layout.description: Bright hallway doorway where two family members greet each other face-to-face and by voice.

positions.where: stepping forward at the front door

props.name: framed hallway family portrait
props.period_detail: wood-framed portrait hanging beside the open door

actions.verb_sequence: hears her voice and sees her face together -> embraces her warmly

reactions.reaction: stand together in effortless unified recognition

scenes.wardrobe: Clean everyday cardigan and collared shirt.
scenes.recognition_hook: Every time you recognize someone you love, your brain seamlessly fuses a geometry match with an emotional chime.
